Class PySession

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.pyffm.PySession
public final class PySession extends Object
An embedded CPython in the Java process (Foreign Function and Memory API): one per process, it can't be stopped and started again. All Python code runs in one thread ("Python"); the calls of other threads wait for it. 
PySession py = PySession.start(PyStartOptions.of(Path.of("/usr/bin/python3")).withConsole((t, e) -> System.out.print(t)));
py.assign("x", PyValue.of(1.0, 2.0, 3.0));
PyValue mean = py.eval("float(sum(x) / len(x))");
py.console("print(x)");
